assertion.statement: The homogeneous rational Lie model in LP02 has a scaled exponential lattice, compact fundamental representatives and compatible homogeneous quotient lattices.
assertion.objects: The finite positive-weight rational Lie algebra u, a homogeneous rational basis, its integer span L0 and exp(D L0).
assertion.hypotheses: D clears the finite rational BCH coefficients; the actual positive-weight filtration and homogeneous quotient ideals have been verified.
assertion.quantifiers: For the fixed homogeneous rational model, all elements of D L0 and every stated homogeneous filtration layer and quotient.
assertion.parameter_range: Fixed finite nilpotency class and dimension.
assertion.uniformity: One standard lattice and compact model are fixed before orbit coefficients and interval lengths vary.
assertion.constants: The scaling D and compact fundamental box depend on the fixed rational model.
assertion.normalizations: BCH linear part is addition; inversion negates logarithms. Reduce coordinates in increasing total weight.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Mapping this lattice into the original Gamma requires the separate rational second-kind coordinate input, not BCH alone.
assertion.limit_order: Choose the rational homogeneous basis, clear BCH denominators, prove subgroup/discreteness and compactness weight by weight, then impose the separately justified image-lattice condition.
